criteria.name: Requested JSON ledger
criteria.description: Returns the target family, all five row IDs, formulas, computed values, final_label, and failed_label.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if most rows are present but formulas, values, or one final label are missing.

criteria.name: Rainfall concentration row
criteria.description: Computes 170.2 mm event precipitation, 152.6 mm wettest 24-hour precipitation, ratios 0.90 and 1.00, 12 heavy-precipitation hours, and 15.7 mm peak hourly precipitation.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 3 points for mostly correct values with minor rounding or one missing metric.

criteria.name: Wind-pressure row
criteria.description: Reports 109.1 km/h peak gust, 53.0 km/h peak wind, ratio 2.06, 991.8 hPa minimum pressure, 14.6 hPa pressure fall, and 17/4 gust-threshold hours.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 3 points for mostly correct values with one or two omissions.

criteria.name: Official-local contrast
criteria.description: Uses 127 kt, 235.2 km/h, 920 hPa, 610 mm, 100 km/h Muscat wind, and official/local gust ratio 2.16 to separate the official cyclone peak from the local point.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct official values with weak contrast logic.

criteria.name: Precipitation product contrast
criteria.description: Compares Open-Meteo 170.2 mm, NASA 69.54 mm, NASA peak 50.68 mm on 20070606, ERA5 46.62/40.26, GPM 84.43/53.43, CHIRPS 59.54/45.48, and ratios 2.45, 0.28, and 1.42.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a partial product comparison or missing ratios.

criteria.name: Receptor density check
criteria.description: Reports population 10576, 1000 OSM elements, 973 buildings, 20 roads, 4 schools, and 92.0 buildings per 1000 people without turning counts into damage totals.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct receptor counts without the density calculation or with an overextended damage claim.

provenance.notes: Values are regenerated from local Cyclone Gonu data files.
